facts.label: Comparativos e superlativos
facts.sub: Curto: cheap, cheaper than, the cheapest. Longo: more expensive than, the most expensive. Irregular: good, better, the best.

facts.label: -er than
facts.sub: Com adjetivos curtos, adicione -er e use than: cheaper than, higher than, older than. old vira older. Não use more com -er.

facts.label: More … than
facts.sub: Com adjetivos longos, use more + adjetivo + than: more expensive than, more difficult than. Não escreva expensiver. Para o oposto, use less expensive than ou cheaper than.

items.s: The superlative uses the before it.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

answers: Cheap becomes cheaper than. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Expensive becomes expensiver. → Falso (It becomes more expensive.)
The superlative uses the before it. → Verdadeiro (Yes: the most expensive.)

pages.title: Comparing bills in Houston · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm Tuesday in Houston. Grace sits at her kitchen table with many papers. The papers are bills, and they are all big. Her friend Clara comes in with a bag of fruit. They want to understand where the money goes. They start to compare their costs.

“Clara, my rent is much higher than last year. Everything is more expensive now.” says Grace. “Mine is cheaper than yours, but my electricity bill is higher.” says Clara. “In summer, the air conditioner makes the bill higher than in winter.” says Grace.
